scenario.prompt: Publish "Healthcare Research Data" at http://localhost:7808 serving a single form widget from these requirements: `trial_readout_form`: name "Trial Readout Form", description "Capture a clinical trial readout note.", endpoint /trial-readout-form, type table, sized w=20 h=10 on the grid, category "Research", params required: readout — a form submitting POST to /trial-readout-submit with inputs [ticker — a text input (type text), labeled "Ticker", default "PFE"; readout_date — a date picker (type date), labeled "Readout date", default "2026-08-19"; save — a button (type button), labeled "Save"] (that bracket is the complete list of the form's inputParams); it caches results for 15 minutes. Time-based config converts to milliseconds: "cache results for N minutes" means staleTime N*60000; "auto-refresh every N seconds" means refetchInterval N*1000..
scenario.title: Compose the Trial Readout Form form widget

notes: Write one JSON object per line.
Use only tools listed in scenario.allowed_tools.
The harness executes calls after the command exits and grades final state.
